facts: Frozen successful scoring consumes RoMa-derived query/reference overlap weights, then independent all-reference weighted MaxSim on ColNomic tokens.
The downstream ColNomic score does not consume the RoMa warp assignment as a required q-to-r token pairing.
P V6/V8 instead use identity values on original RoMa-assigned reference tokens and newly constrained regions.
These are different information paths; old recognition gains do not validate the new hard-assignment P path.
limits: RoMa overlap maps can themselves contain candidate-specific and spatial information; this is not a proof that all geometry is irrelevant.
No natural assignment intervention has isolated how much this transition causes P ranking failures.
No raw model forward, training, data mutation or new scientific GO was performed.
